summary: Diff implements security headers (REQ-2) and friendly TanStack Router 404/500 pages (REQ-6), and adds frontend validation utilities plus some usage in order-related mutations (partial REQ-4). However, HTTPS enforcement is not shown as being invoked (REQ-1 incomplete), CSRF token flow is explicitly not implemented (REQ-5 missing), and backend-side input validation and comprehensive rate-limit enforcement across all mutating shared methods are not verifiable from the provided backend diff (REQ-3/REQ-4 likely incomplete).

missing_requirements.requirement: Force HTTPS for all app pages by implementing a client-side redirect whenever the app is loaded over http:, preserving the full path, query string, and hash during the redirect; do not run during localhost/dev; avoid infinite loops.
missing_requirements.reason: An HTTPS enforcement utility was added, but the diff summary does not show it being called from the app startup/entry (e.g., App/root component or main entry file), so the redirect behavior is not implemented end-to-end based on the provided changes.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure basic rate limiting is applied to all state-changing backend entrypoints by auditing backend/main.mo and adding checkRateLimit(...) enforcement anywhere it is missing for shared update methods that mutate state or perform privileged actions.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo shows a checkRateLimit function and related security state/stats, but the diff summary is truncated and does not provide evidence that all state-mutating shared update methods actually call checkRateLimit before mutating state.

missing_requirements.requirement: Validate and sanitize all user-controlled inputs on both frontend and backend (trim, max lengths, allowed charset, validate DOB/ZIP/state/gender/height/IDs) before storing or using them.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend validation utilities were added and used in some mutations (e.g., create order, set tracking number), but the diff does not show backend-side validation/sanitization, and does not demonstrate coverage for all required structured fields (notably DOB) and all user-controlled inputs across the app.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add CSRF protection via a backend method to mint/return a caller-scoped token and require/validate it for mutating backend calls from the UI.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend CSRF hook explicitly states backend token generation is not implemented and returns null; mutations contain comments about future token usage but still call backend mutators without a token. No backend mint/validate methods are shown.

hallucinated_features.description: Blocklist/allowlist administration capabilities (and related UI mutation hooks) beyond the requested per-principal rate limiting and stats/events.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest asks for rate limiting enforcement and recording allowed/denied/throttled events, but does not request implementing explicit allowlist/blocklist management features.
